description: This file defines the 'ECUEditorMenuBar' class, which extends JMenuBar and implements ActionListener. It constructs and manages the menu bar for the ECU editor application, including menus such as Edit, View, and Help, and handles actions like opening dialogs, saving images, and adjusting user levels.

classes.name: ECUEditorMenuBar
classes.description: A custom menu bar for the ECU editor application, providing menus for editing, viewing, and help, and handling user interactions through action events.

methods.name: updateMenu
methods.description: Updates the menu items' state based on the last selected ROM file, enabling or disabling options accordingly.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles action events triggered by menu item selections, executing corresponding functionalities such as opening dialogs, adjusting user levels, or displaying information.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the currently selected ROM image to a user-specified file.

methods.name: getImageOutputFile
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a file location for saving the ROM image.

methods.name: writeImage
methods.description: Writes the byte array of the ROM image to the specified file.

methods.name: getRepositoryOutputDir
methods.description: Shows a directory chooser dialog for selecting a repository directory.

methods.name: saveAsRepository
methods.description: Exports current tables to the selected repository directory as text files.

methods.name: increaseRomSize
methods.description: Converts the ROM image size from 160KB to 192KB and saves it.

methods.name: decreaseRomSize
methods.description: Converts the ROM image size from 192KB back to 160KB and saves it.

methods.name: getLastSelectedRomFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the last selected ROM, for display purposes.
